tei:div.tei:p: (nya)༄༅// nyi ma sbas pas mdzad ba'i rgya gzhung gi las tshogs kyi bsdus don bzhugs// ༄༅// rje btsun ma 'phags ma sgrol ma la phyag 'tshal lo// phyag 'tshal nyi shu rtsa gcig yan lag dang bcas pa 'di la gsum/ phyag 'tshal nyi shu rtsa gcig gi gzhung bde bar gshegs pa'i bka' dang*/ de'i rjes su slob dpon klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa'i spyi'i sgrub thabs dang*/ de'i rjes su slob dpon nyi ma sbas pas mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs yan lag dang bcas pa'o// gong ma gnyis ni rtogs par sla'o// nyi ma sbas pas mdzad pa 'di la gnyis/ sgrub pa'i thabs dang*/ de dag gi las kyi yan lag go /sgrub pa'i thabs la nyi shu rtsa gcig ste/ dang po myur zhing rab tu dpa' ba dang*/ gnyis pa ston ka'i zla ba ltar dkar ba dang*/ gsum pa gser gyi mdog can dang*/ bzhi pa de bzhin gshegs pa'i gtsug tor rnam par rgyal ma dang*/ lnga pa hūm̐ gi sgra rab tu sgrogs ma dang*/ drug pa 'jig rten gsum las rnam par rgyal ma dang*/ bdun pa gzhan 'joms ma dang*/ brgyad pa bdud thams cad 'joms shing dbang mchog ster ba dang*/ dgu pa mchog stsol ba dang*/ bcu pa mya ngan sel bar byed pa dang*/ bcu gcig pa 'gro ba thams cad 'gugs shing phongs pa thams cad sel ba dang*/ bcu gnyis pa bkra shis thams cad sbyin pa dang*/ bcu gsum pa yongs su smin pa dang*/ bcu bzhi pa 'gugs pa'i khro mo dang*/ bco lnga pa zhi ba chen mo dang*/ bcu drug pa thams cad 'joms pa dang*/ bcu bdun pa bde ba thams cad sgrub pa dang*/ bco brgyad pa rnam par rgyal ma dang*/ bcu dgu pa sdug bsngal thams cad bsreg pa dang*/ nyi shu pa dngos grub thams cad 'byung ba dang*/ rtsa gcig pa yongs su rdzogs par byed pa'i sgrub thabs so// spyi don gnyis pa las kyi yan lag la gsum/ klad kyi don dang*/ gzhung gi don dang*/ mjug gi don no// gzhung la gnyis/ so so'i las kyi yan lag dang*/ spyi'i don no// so so'i yan lag la nyi shu rtsa gcig yod pa las/

dang po nas rim gyis brjod par bya'o// de la sgrol ma myur zhing rab tu dpa' ba'i las kyi yan lag phyir bzlog pa'i cho ga la lnga/ bya ba'i dus dang*/ gang zag dang*/ dgos pa dang*/ cho ga dang*/ bzlas pa'o// cho ga la gsum/ sbyor ba dang*/ dngos gzhi dang*/ rjes so// sbyor ba la drug stegs bu dang*/ brub khung bya ba dang*/ liṅga bya ba dang*/ gzungs thag gdags pa dang*/ sbu gu bya ba dang*/ de dag gi bar gyi dmigs pa dang*/ mchod rten legs par mnan pa'o// dngos gzhi la gsum/ 'jug pa'i sngon rol du gtor ma gtang ba dang*/ lha'i rnal 'byor bsgom pa dang*/ dmigs pa dang ldan par sngags kyi thun bya ba'o// 'jug pa'i cho ga la gnyis/ sbyin sreg dang mnan pa'o// bzlas pa la gnyis/ bum pa la bri ba'i sngags dang*/ rgyun du bzlas pa'i sngags so// las kyi yan lag dang po'i bsdus don no// gnyis pa ston ka'i zla ba ltar dkar ba'i las kyi yan lag yams nad zhi ba la bzhi/ dgos pa dang*/ dus dang*/ cho ga dang*/ phan yon gsang sngags dang bcas pa'o// cho ga la gsum/ sbyor ba dang*/ dngos gzhi dang*/ mjug tu bya ba'o// sbyor ba la bzhi/ stegs bu brtsig pa dang*/ dkyil 'khor bri ba dang*/ rgyan dgram pa dang*/ gdan bsham pa'o// dngos gzhi la gnyis/ bsnyen pa dang sgrub pa'o// dang po la bzhi/ bdag nyid rnal 'byor dang ldan pas dkyil 'khor bskyed cing mchod pa dang*/ chos skyong la gtor ma sbyin pa dang*/ gso sbyong dang ldan pas gsang sngags brgya phrag re song ba dang mchod pa dang*/ gsol ba gdab pa'o// mjug tu bya ba'i cho ga la gnyis/ yams bdag mo bskang ba dang*/ dkyil 'khor kyi rdzas rnams gzhug pa'i mchod rten brtsig pa'o// las kyi yan lag gnyis pa'o// gsum pa gser gyi mdog can gyi las kyi yan lag tshe 'phel ba la bzhi/ dgos pa dang*/ gnas dang*/ cho ga dang*/ phan yon 'byung bar bstan pa'o// cho ga la bzhi/ sngon du 'gro ba'i bya ba dang*/

lha'i rnal 'byor sngags dang bcas te bstan pa dang*/ lha'i rnal 'byor gyi mjug tu bya ba dang*/ rlung gi rnal 'byor bstan pa'o// las kyi yan lag gsum pa'o// bzhi pa gtsug tor rnam rgyal gyi las kyi yan lag dug bsad pa la gsum/ dgos pa dang cho ga dang*/ phan yon sngags dang bcas pa'o// cho ga la gsum/ bsnyen pa sngon du song bas sgrub pa dang*/ las la sbyar ba'o// las kyi yan lag bzhi pa'o// lnga pa hūm̐ gi sgra rab tu sgrogs pa'i las kyi yan lag dbang du bya ba la gnyis/ dgos pa dang*/ cho ga'o// de la gsum/ nye bar bsnyen pa dang*/ sgrub pa dang*/ las la sbyar ba'o// dang po la bzhi/ 'khor lo dang*/ liṅga bca' ba dang*/ me la gdung ba dang*/ khab kyis brud pa ste rdzas kyi rten 'brel dang*/ ting nge 'dzin dang tshe'i chu sbyin pa'o// sgrub pa la gsum/ rdzas kyi sgrub pa dang*/ ting nge 'dzin gyi sgrub pa dang*/ sngags kyi sgrub pa'o// las la sbyar ba la drug me tog sbyin pa dang*/ bza' btung sbyin pa dang*/ sbyin sreg bya ba dang*/ yungs kar bsnun pa dang*/ gsol ba gdab pa dang*/ mig sman gyi sgrub pa gnyis kyis las la sbyar ba'o// las kyi yan lag lnga pa'o// drug pa 'jig rten gsum las rnam rgyal gyi las kyi yan lag sgrib pa sbyong ba la drug dgos pa dang*/ dus dang*/ spang bya dang*/ gnas dang*/ cho ga dang*/ gsang sngags bstan pa'o// cho ga la gsum/ sbyor ba dang*/ dngos gzhi dang*/ mjug go /dang po la gsum/ dkyil 'khor bri ba dang*/ mchod pa bsham pa dang*/ gtor ma bsham pa'o// dngos gzhi la gsum/ dkyil 'khor bskyed la mchod pa dang*/ gsol ba gdab pa dang*/ lha'i rnal 'byor dang ldan pas bzlas brjod bya ba'o// mjug la bzhi/ sdig pa bshags pa dang*/ bsreg pa dang*/ bkru ba dang*/ sdig pa dag pa'i ltas phan yon dang bcas pa'o// las kyi yan lag drug pa'o// bdun pa gzhan 'joms ma zhes bya ba'i las kyi yan lag 'pho ba la bzhi/

'chi ltas dang*/ 'chi bslu dang 'pho ba'i cho ga dang*/ de'i phan yon no// cho ga la gnyis/ sbyang ba dang*/ las la sbyar ba'o// las kyi yan lag bdun pa'o// brgyad pa bdud thams cad 'joms shing dbang mchog ster ba zhes bya ba'i las kyi yan lag rdzogs rim bsgom pa la gnyis/ phan yon sngon du 'gro bas bskyed pa'i rim pa sbyang ba dang*/ rdzogs rim dngos so// de la bzhi/ las kyi phyag rgya dang*/ dam tshig gi phyag rgya dang*/ chos kyi phyag rgya dang*/ phyag rgya chen po'o// dang po la lnga/ phyag rgya'i mtshan nyid dang*/ de sbyang ba dang*/ bdag dang phyag rgya byin gyis brlab pa dang*/ dga' ba bzhi'i nyams su myong ba bsgom pa dang*/ byang chub kyi sems dbab bzlog gi thabs bstan pa'o// las kyi yan lag brgyad pa'o// dgu pa mchog gsol ba'i las kyi yan lag rab gnas la gnyis/ don dam pa'i rang bzhin dang*/ kun rdzob tu rab tu gnas pa'o// de la bzhi/ rab gnas byas pa'i phan yon dang*/ ma byas pa'i nyes pa dang*/ cho ga dang*/ phan yon rgyas par bstan pa'o// cho ga la gsum/ sbyor ba dang*/ dngos gzhi dang*/ mjug go /dang po la bzhi/ rten gyi mtshan nyid dang*/ stegs bu brtsig pa dang*/ dus la sogs pa bkra shis pa btsal ba dang*/ mchod pa'i yo byad bsham pa'o// dngos gzhi la bdun/ bdag gi rnal 'byor dang*/ bum pa la bzlas pa bya ba dang*/ rten sbyang ba dang*/ yan lag bzhi rdzogs kyis bskyed pa dang*/ mchod de spyan dbye ba dang*/ de dag gi gsang sngags bstan pa dang*/ mnga' dbul ba'o// mjug la gsum/ gtor ma byin te chos skyong bsgo ba dang*/ sbyin sreg bya ba dang*/ yon dbul ba'o// las kyi yan lag dgu pa'o// bcu pa mya ngan sel ba zhes bya ba'i las kyi yan lag dbang bskur ba'i cho ga la gnyis/ dbang gi dgos pa dang*/ cho ga'i bya ba'o// de la gsum/ mtshan nyid brtag cing gsol ba gdab pa dang*/ sngon du bsnyen pa'i cho ga dang*/ dkyil 'khor dang 'brel pa'i bya ba'o// bsnyen pa la gsum/

slob ma bsrung ba dang*/ gnas blang ba dang*/ bsnyen pa dngos so// dkyil 'khor dang 'brel pa la gsum/ sa'i cho ga dang*/ sta gon gyi cho ga dang*/ dkyil 'khor zhag gi cho ga'o// dang po la mngon rtogs las bstan kyang sa sbyang ba'i cho ga dang*/ gzung ba'i cho ga gnyis su bsdu na/ sta gon la gsum/ lha lhag par gnas pa dang*/ bum pa lhag par gnas pa dang*/ slob ma lhag par gnas pa'o// dang po la bzhi/ dri'i thig le dang*/ tshom bu bya ba dang*/ lha rnams bskyed cing sngags kyi byin gyis brlab pa dang*/ mchod cing bstod de snyan gsan dbab gsol ba gdab pa'o// bum pa la gsum/ tshul bzhin du bsham pa dang*/ byin gyis brlab pa dang*/ bzlas pas mnyes par bya ba'o// slob ma lhag par gnas pa la bcu ste byang chub kyi sems bskyed pa dang*/ tha mal pa'i rgyud sbyang ba dang*/ dbang gi don du gsol ba gdab pa dang*/ rdo rje theg pa'i lam la spro ba khyad par can bskyed pa dang*/ myur bar 'dod pa'i sems bskyed pa dang*/ bsrung zhing mchod pa dang*/ so shing dang*/ chos zab mo bshad pa dang*/ rmi lam gyi bar chad bsrung ba'i phyir srung skud gdags pa dang*/ ku sha sbyin zhing rmi lam brtag pa'o// dkyil 'khor zhag gi dus su bya ba la bzhi/ bri ba dang byin gyis brlab pa dang*/ nus pa dang ldan pa'i mchod pas mchod pa dang*/ 'jug cing dbang bskur ba'o// dang po la gnyis/ thig gis bri ba dang*/ rdul tshon gyis bri ba'o// thig la gnyis/ ye shes kyi thig gi byin gyis brlab pa dang*/ las kyi thig gis cha bgo ba'o// tshon la gsum byin gyis brlab pa dang*/ tshon dgye zhing mtshan ma dgod pa dang*/ der bum pa sogs dbul zhing mchod pa bsham pa'o// byin gyis brlab pa la gnyis/ dam tshig pa bskyed pas byin gyis brlab pa dang*/ ye shes pa gzhug pas byin gyis brlab pa'o// mchod pa la gnyis/ mchod pa rgyas pas mchod pa dang*/ gtor mas mchod pa'o// spyi don tha ma 'jug cing dbang bskur ba la gnyis/

'jug pa dang dbang bskur ba'o// 'jug pa la gnyis/ slob dpon bdag nyid 'jug pa dang*/ slob ma gzhug pa'o// de la gnyis/ yol ba'i phyi 'jug dang*/ nang 'jug go /de la bzhi/ me tog dor zhing mgo la bcing ba dang*/ ye shes dbab pa dang*/ dam la gzhag pa dang*/ dkyil 'khor bstan pa'o// dbang la bzhi/ rdo rje slob dpon dang*/ gsang ba dang*/ shes rab ye shes dang*/ bzhi pa'o// dang po la gnyis/ yon dbul zhing gsol ba gdab pa dang*/ dbang bskur ba'o// dbang gi cho ga la gnyis/ slob dpon dang slob ma thun mong gi dbang dang*/ rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang ngo*// dang po la gnyis/ rig pa'i dbang dang*/ rjes la bya ba'o// dang po la lnga/ chu/ cod pan/ rdo rje/ dril bu/ rigs dang rjes su mthun pa'i ming ngo*// rjes la bya ba la bzhi/ sngags kyi dbang dang*/ brtul zhugs dang*/ lung bstan pa dang*/ dbugs dbyung ba'o// slob dpon gyi dbang la gnyis/ yon dbul zhing gsol ba gdab pa dang*/ dbang bskur ba'o// de la gnyis/ dam tshig gsum sbyin pa dang*/ de la 'brel pa'i rjes su gnang ba la sogs sbyin pa'o// gsang dbang la gnyis/ yon dbul zhing gsol ba gdab pa dang*/ dam tshig gi rdzas lce la byin te dbang bskur ba'o// shes rab ye shes la gnyis/ yon dang 'brel ba'i gsol ba gdab pa dang*/ dbang sbyin pa'o// de la gsum/ rig ma rjes su gtad pa'i cho ga dang*/ dga' bzhi nyams myong bskyed pa dang*/ de nas slob ma la gdams pa'i bya ba bstan pa'o// thams cad kyi rjes kyi bya ba la bzhi/ 'khor lo mchod pa dang*/ cho ga ma tshang ba dang lhag pa bzod par gsol ba dang*/ tshogs bya ba dang*/ dam tshig bstan pa'o// las kyi yan lag bcu pa'o// bcu gcig pa 'gro ba thams cad 'gugs shing phongs pa thams cad sel ba'i las kyi yan lag longs spyod spel ba la bzhi/ dgos pa dang*/ sbyin sreg dang*/ gter gzhug pa dang*/ bzlas pa'i sngags so// las kyi yan lag bcu gcig pa'o// bcu gnyis pa bkra shis thams cad sbyin pa'i las kyi yan lag la gnyis/

phan yon dang*/ cho ga dngos so// de la gnyis/ zhi ba'i sbyin sreg dang*/ las gzhan des bsgres te bstan pa'o// dang po la gsum/ sbyor ba dang*/ dngos gzhi dang mjug go /sbyor ba la brgyad/ dus dang*/ gnas dang*/ sa'i cho ga dang*/ thab khung gi khyad par dang*/ bsreg rdzas dang*/ mchod rdzas bsham thabs dang*/ bud shing gi khyad par dang*/ dgang gzar blugs gzar gyi mtshan nyid bstan pa'o// dngos gzhi la bzhi/ bdag nyid kyi bya ba dang*/ thab dang 'brel ba'i bya ba dang*/ 'jig rten pa'i me lha mchod pa dang*/ 'das pa'i me lha mchod pa'o// 'jig rten pa'i me lha mchod pa la drug bskyed pa dang*/ byon zan dbul ba dang*/ me pra brtag pa dang*/ mchod pa dang bsreg rdzas rgyas par dbul ba dang*/ 'dod pa'i don blang ba dang*/ 'bar ba'i rnam par thim pa'o// 'das pa'i me lha mchod pa la lnga/ bskyed cing dgug pa dang*/ mchod cing bstod pa dang*/ bzod par gsol ba dang*/ 'dod pa'i don gsol ba gdab pa dang*/ gshegs su gsol ba'o// mjug gi cho ga la lnga/ lha bskyed pa dang*/ mchod cing bstod pa dang*/ bzod par gsol zhing 'dod pa blang ba dang*/ ye shes pa gshegs shing dam tshig pa mi dmigs par bya ba dang*/ yi ge brgya pas kha bskangs shing thab khung bsdu ba'o// las kyi yan lag bcu gnyis pa'o// bcu gsum pa yongs su smin par byed pa'i las kyi yan lag 'byung po bzlog pa la gsum/ phan yon dang*/ cho ga dang*/ sngags bzlas pa'i grangs dang bcas pa'o// cho ga la bzhi/ rdzas sbyar ba dang*/ lha'i rnal 'byor dang*/ zhi ba dang bsrung ba dang bskrad pa dang*/ bgegs bsad pa'i cho ga'o// las kyi yan lag bcu gsum pa'o// bcu bzhi pa 'gugs pa'i khro mo'i las kyi yan lag srung 'khor la gsum/ dgos pa dang*/ cho ga dang*/ phan yon no// cho ga la lnga/ bri ba'i gzhi dang*/ dbyibs kyi khyad par dang*/ snag tsha dang*/ bris nas sgrub pa dang*/ bcang ba'o// las kyi yan lag bcu bzhi pa'o// bco lnga pa zhi ba chen mo bzhi'i las kyi yan lag khrus kyi cho ga la gsum/

dgos pa dang*/ cho ga dang gsang sngags so// cho ga la brgyad/ gnas dang*/ dkyil 'khor dang*/ bum pa bca' ba dang*/ yo byad dgram pa dang*/ cho ga nyams su blang ba dang*/ khrus bya ba dang*/ mjug gi bya ba dang*/ phan yon bstan pa'o// las kyi yan lag bco lnga pa'o// bcu drug pa thams cad 'joms pa'i las kyi yan lag blo 'phel bar bya ba la gsum/ dgos pa dang*/ cho ga dang*/ sgrub pa dang*/ gzungs sngags bstan pa'o// cho ga la gnyis/ bsgom pa dang bzlas pas bsgrub pa dang*/ de'i steng du rdzas la brten te sgrub pa tshul mi 'dra ba bzhi'o// las kyi yan lag bcu drug pa'o// bcu bdun pa bde ba thams cad sgrub pa'i las kyi yan lag chom rkun bcing ba la gsum/ dgos pa dang*/ cho ga dang*/ gzungs sngags so// cho ga la bdun/ gnas dang*/ rten bsham pa dang*/ bsam pa dang ldan pas sngon du 'gro ba'i gtor ma dang*/ mchod pa dbul ba dang*/ bdag gi rnal 'byor dang*/ gtor ma gnyis pa gtang ba dang*/ las la sbyar ba'o// las kyi yan lag bcu bdun pa'o// bco brgyad pa rnam par rgyal ba'i las kyi yan lag klu nad gso ba'i las kyi yan lag la gsum/ gnod pa'i rgyu dang*/ gnod pa'i rtags dang*/ gso ba'i cho ga'o// gnod pa'i rtags la lnga/ spyir gnod pa'i rtags dang*/ sha mdangs bar du zhugs pa dang*/ sha la babs pa dang*/ rtsa rgyus la babs pa dang*/ rus pa la zhugs pa'o// gso ba'i thabs la yang drug spyir gso ba dang*/ sha mdangs bar du zhugs pa gso ba dang*/ sha la babs pa gso ba dang*/ rtsa rgyus la zhugs pa gso ba dang*/ rus pa la zhugs pa gso ba dang*/ thun mong gi sngags bstan pa'o// las kyi yan lag bco brgyad pa'o// bcu dgu pa sdug bsngal thams cad sreg par byed pa'i las kyi yan lag khri mon las thar pa la lnga/ dgos pa dang*/ rten bsham pa dang*/ nye bar bsnyen pa dang*/ sgrub pa dang*/ gsang sngags bstan pa'o// las kyi yan lag bcu dgu pa'o// nyi shu pa dngos grub thams cad 'byung ba'i las kyi yan lag mi snang ba sgrub pa la lnga/

dgos pa dang*/ rdzas bsag pa dang*/ sgrub pa dang*/ las la sbyar ba dang*/ gsang sngags bstan pa'o// las kyi yan lag nyi shu pa'o// nyi shu rtsa gcig pa yongs su rdzogs par byed pa'i las kyi yan lag mkha' spyod sgrub pa la lnga/ dgos pa dang*/ ral gri bya ba dang*/ sgrub pa dang*/ las la sbyar ba dang*/ gsang sngags bstan pa'o// las kyi yan lag nyi shu rtsa gcig pa ste so so'i las kyi yan lag bstan pa'o// spyi'i las kyi yan lag la lnga/ gtor ma dang*/ chu sbyin dang*/ sātstsha dang*/ dus gsum brtag pa dang*/ bud med dang bu chung la phan gdags pa'o// gtor ma la bzhi/ snod dang*/ rdzas dang*/ byin gyis brlab pa dang*/ bsngo ba'o// chu sbyin la bzhi/ yo byad dang*/ ting nge 'dzin dang*/ sngags kyi grangs dang*/ sngags bstan pa'o// sātstsha la lnga/ rgyu dang*/ byin gyis brlabs te gdab pa dang*/ rab tu gnas pa byas te mchod pa dang*/ bzhugs sar spyan drang ba dang*/ gsang sngags bstan pa'o// dus gsum rmi lam brtag pa la bdun/ gang zag dang*/ rdzas dang*/ sngags kyi tshad dang*/ dus dang*/ nyal tshul dang*/ bsam pa dang*/ gsol ba gdab cing gsang sngags bstan pa'o// bud med dang bu chung la phan gdags pa la gsum/ dgos pa dang*/ cho ga dang*/ gsang sngags bstan pa'o// cho ga la lnga/ sbrum ma la phan gdags pa la lnga/ sbrum ma bde bar btsa' ba dang*/ mgo mjug ldog pa la bde bar btsa' ba dang*/ mo gsham bu bskyed pa dang*/ sri'u bsrung ba dang*/ 'byung po bzlog pa'o// spyi'i las kyi yan lag bstan zin to// //nyi shu rtsa gcig yan lag dang bcas pa'i// bsdus don dge bsnyen grags pa rgyal mtshan la// sma klu lo ston dge slong dkon mchog grags// de yis gsol ba btab nas 'bad de bris// de las byung ba'i dge ba dri med des// nam mkha'i mthas gtugs gyur pa'i sems can dang*// skul bar byed pa cang ston dang bcas pa// kun mkhyen rgyal ba'i go 'phang thob par shog /phyag 'tshal nyi shu rtsa gcig pa'i lam gyi yan lag dang bcas pa'i bsdus don rdzogs so/// /
༈ gu rus dpar rtsa spel ba'o//
